stories.title: Using AI, mathematician claims to have solved one of math’s great mysteries
stories.simple_summary: A mathematician says they used an AI tool to help solve a very difficult math problem that experts have been stuck on for a long time. This is exciting because it shows AI can help with serious intellectual work.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to mathematicians and investors. For ordinary people and small business owners, there's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Principal: Juvenile used AI to make nude images of Chatham Co. charter school students & staff
stories.simple_summary: A young person at a school used AI to create fake nude pictures of other students and staff members. The school principal caught this and reported it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work with young people or run a school, you should know that AI tools can be misused this way. Talk to children in your life about not using technology to hurt others.

stories.title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims to Solve Riemann Hypothesis With Help From Claude
stories.simple_summary: A person at a company called Anthropic claims their AI called Claude helped solve a famous unsolved math problem. This is the same story as the first headline.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to mathematicians and investors. For ordinary people and small business owners, there's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Anthropic may have solved major maths problem Reimann hypothesis
stories.simple_summary: A company might have solved a very hard math puzzle with the help of AI technology. Mathematicians are still checking if this is correct.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to mathematicians and investors. For ordinary people and small business owners, there's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Jensen Huang Was Reportedly Fixated on Humiliation
stories.simple_summary: A story has come out about a business leader's management style. The headline suggests he treated employees harshly.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about a company's internal problems and mostly matters to investors. It doesn't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. government is threatening to tax companies heavily if they build AI computer centers in other countries instead of America. This is about where expensive computer equipment gets built.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects large companies and investors. If you own a small business, you probably won't feel the impact directly.

stories.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
stories.simple_summary: The founder of Spotify is investing money in a company that is trying to build a new type of power plant using fusion energy. An AI researcher is leading this company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. For now, it doesn't affect small business owners or ordinary people.

stories.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
stories.simple_summary: AI has claimed to solve a very hard math problem that stumped experts for over 150 years. At the same time, a human mathematician has also come up with a solution.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to mathematicians and investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
stories.simple_summary: The government is warning companies they will face heavy taxes if they build expensive computer centers outside the United States. This is a policy about where companies can build their equipment.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects large companies and investors. For small businesses and ordinary people, the impact is minimal right now.

stories.title: If I Could Only Own 1 Trillion-Dollar Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Through 2030, It Would Be Anthropic, Nvidia, or Alphabet. Here’s My Top Pick.
stories.simple_summary: An investment expert is saying that one of three companies will be a great investment choice for people who want to own AI stocks over the next ten years. This is an investment opinion piece.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for investors only. If you're not investing in company stocks, you don't need to worry about this.

stories.title: Chips can survive the space environment — can their financing?
stories.simple_summary: Banks are nervous about lending money for computer equipment that companies want to shoot into space because they worry about losing their money. This creates a problem for companies trying to build data centers in orbit.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a specialized finance and technology issue. For most small business owners and ordinary people, this doesn't matter.

stories.title: Exclusive | Nestle Eyes Autonomous Factory Lines and Looks to Google, Microsoft as Partners
stories.simple_summary: The company Nestle is looking at using AI-controlled factory equipment to make their products and might work with big tech companies like Google and Microsoft. This is about automating their manufacturing.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a manufacturing business, pay attention. Automation is becoming more common. For other small businesses and consumers, there's nothing urgent to do yet.
